export.title: Export results
export.description: Exports every document the current query or pipeline returns, not only the loaded ones.
export.jsonArrayHint: One file holding an array of documents.
export.ndjsonHint: One document per line. Best for large exports.
export.csvHint: A table for spreadsheets. Nested values become JSON text.
export.canonicalHint: Re-imports without changing any type. Recommended.
export.relaxed: Readable numbers and dates (relaxed Extended JSON)
export.relaxedHint: Easier for other tools, but numbers may change type when imported back.
export.fieldsHint: Dotted paths such as address.city read nested fields.
export.cancelled: Export cancelled. No file was written.
export.nothing: No document matches the query: the file would be empty.

import.title: Import documents
import.description: Imports documents from a JSON, NDJSON or CSV file into {{namespace}}.
import.stopOnError: Stop at the first failing document
import.stopOnErrorHint: Otherwise failing documents are skipped and listed at the end.
import.cancelled: Import cancelled. Documents inserted before cancelling stay in the collection.

mode.title: Existing documents
mode.insertHint: Documents whose _id already exists fail and are listed at the end.
mode.upsertHint: An existing document is replaced by the incoming one; new ones are inserted.
mode.mergeHint: The incoming fields are set on the existing document; other fields are kept.

dropFirst.collectionHint: Deletes every document before importing. Indexes are kept.
dropFirst.databaseHint: Deletes every document of the collections being imported. Other collections are not touched.
dropFirst.copyCollectionHint: Drops it first, indexes included, so it ends up identical to the source.
dropFirst.copyDatabaseHint: Drops each target collection that has a source counterpart first. Other collections are not touched.

export.title: Export database
export.description: Writes each collection of {{database}} to its own file, in a folder named after the database.
export.none: This database has no collections to export.
export.cancelled: Export cancelled. Files already written stay in the folder.

import.title: Import into database
import.description: Imports a folder of JSON or NDJSON files into {{database}}: each file becomes the collection named after it.
import.done: Imported {{collections, number}} collections: {{documents, number}} documents inserted, {{updated, number}} updated.
import.cancelled: Import cancelled. Documents imported before cancelling stay in the database.

copy.collectionDescription: Copies the documents, options and indexes of {{source}} to another connection, or under a new name.
copy.databaseDescription: Copies every collection and view of {{source}}, with their options and indexes, to another connection or database.
copy.targetHint: Only open connections are listed. Connect to a server to copy to it.
copy.ontoItself: Choose another database or name: a collection cannot be copied onto itself.
copy.indexesHint: Recreated after the documents. An index that fails, such as a unique one over duplicates, is reported.
copy.noTargets: No open connection accepts writes. Connect to a server that is not read-only to copy to it.
copy.done_one: Copied {{count, number}} collection: {{documents, number}} documents inserted, {{updated, number}} updated.
copy.done_other: Copied {{count, number}} collections: {{documents, number}} documents inserted, {{updated, number}} updated.
copy.cancelled: Copy cancelled. Documents copied before cancelling stay in the target.
